_meta.blurb: Absence is part of the map. These are deliberate holds — not backlog shame.

held.why: Design-system craft talk — no stable company operating model to map.
Discovery coaching episode — thesis never cleared the org-specificity gate.
Ads playbook, not a product-org operating system.
Multi-guest festival roundup — no single org bet.
Education business, not how a product company runs discovery/delivery.
Content-MBA productization — useful, but off the org-map promise.
PM school as product — held until we treat education orgs as a deliberate cluster.
Agency growth philosophy overlaps Product Hackers’ other card — needs a sharper unique bet.
Second Product Hackers voice — still too generic vs Factorial’s growth loop.
Voicemod thesis is role philosophy more than Voicemod’s operating system.
School org shape without a distinguishing operating choice.
Career montage across firms — not enough steady-state KingMakers detail.
Mostly Factorial philosophy via Itnig — Factorial already published.

tension_seeds.note: Ting sells talk-time back to sales reps; GetInvoice is a solo-founder loop automating SMB invoice pain without a classic product org.

tension_seeds.axis: Is community the product or the halo?
tension_seeds.note: Nova Talent builds a premium B2C professional community on top of B2B headhunting; Thiga treats La Product Conf as positioning infrastructure so consulting rides the community halo.

tension_seeds.axis: How does retail digital earn its keep?
tension_seeds.note: Decathlon Outdoor uses the app to sell experiences, not only gear; IskayPet ships digital only when stores and category P&L can absorb it.
Mercado Libre judges bets by how they compound the ecosystem; Cabify balances two-sided liquidity as one system.

tension_seeds.axis: What is the learning/health distribution channel?
tension_seeds.note: Eva used conversational AI as the channel for teen public-health content; Nominis teaches kids English like Netflix — stories and gamification over drills.
